title: Effects of hydrostatic compression and kinetic vitrification on structural relaxation behaviors of amorphous drugs: how to predict them via simple theoretical models?
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25675-25693
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03931B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tran Dinh Cuong, Anh D. Phan
A novel chemical mapping is developed to capture the relaxation behaviors of amorphous drugs. This result can be utilized to improve the stability of medicines during tablet manufacturing at high pressures and long-term storage at low temperatures.
